title.zh: Crypto hacking group ShinyHunters says it stole data of 5,000 FBI agents
title.en: Crypto hacking group ShinyHunters says it stole data of 5,000 FBI agents

current_state.zh: Crypto hacking collective ShinyHunters claims it breached FBI databases and stole personal details of 5,000 agents, sharing samples that Reuters partially verified, and says the theft was retaliation for a May 2026 FBI report on the group.
